1.1.20 — Privacy & Safety

  • Private windows (⇧⌘N): no history, nothing saved, and every cookie and sign-in is forgotten when you close the window.
  • Tracking tags removed from links. utm_, fbclid, gclid and friends come off when you click or copy a link.
  • A safer assistant. Pages and search results are read as information, never as instructions, answers have no hidden links, and research happens in a signed-out session.
  • OpenAI conversations are marked not to be stored.
  • Settings › Privacy & Safety shows every protection at a glance.

1.1.19 — Readable on every card

  • Member cards now pick their text and pattern colors from what's behind them, so your name reads clearly on every design.

1.1.18 — Your member card

  • Every Pane member now gets a card of their own: a one-of-a-kind pattern and colors, your name, when you joined and your member number.
  • Make yours in Settings › Membership (new installs make it during the welcome) and watch it come to life. Hover over it and it tilts toward you.
  • Make a new design any time, or save your card as an image to share.
